title: [YouPass Collect] - Village Park Changes Over A Decade
prompt: The map shows the village park, now and 10 years ago. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps illustrate the changes that have taken place in a village park over 10 years.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the park has undergone significant development, with several new facilities being added and existing ones expanded. Notably, the natural features have been replaced by recreational amenities.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the sports and parking facilities, the tennis courts, originally located in the northwest with only 2 courts, have doubled in number to 4 courts and now occupy a larger area in the same position. The football pitch, which was previously situated in the southwest corner, has been relocated to a more central location. Additionally, the car park has been substantially enlarged, with its capacity increasing from 20 to 50 cars, and has been repositioned to the northwest area.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the new additions and removed features, the most noticeable change is the introduction of several new amenities. A children's soft play area and public toilets have been constructed on the eastern side of the park. In the southeast, where woods once stood, a cafe has been built. The pond in the south-central area has been transformed into a picnic area. Furthermore, a cycle path now encircles the entire perimeter of the park. The original children's play area has been relocated to the northeast corner, while the pond and woods have been completely removed to accommodate these modern facilities.
